verdict.rationale: Official GPU SDKs are a fair axis for a graphics card. NVIDIA's first-party docs describe the CUDA Toolkit (C/C++ compiler, runtime, GPU-accelerated libraries, Nsight tools), cuTile Python and CUDA Tile C++, NGC containers with GPU-accelerated SDKs, and the RTX 5080 page explicitly offers curated GPU-optimized SDKs for PyTorch, Ollama and Windows ML. An llms.txt on the developer portal adds AI-native discoverability. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building with these SDKs on the RTX 5080, and an explicit RTX 5080/Blackwell support statement in the CUDA Toolkit docs themselves.
